### Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida
### End Semester Examination, 2024 (Even)
### B.Tech, II Semester

**Course Title: Software Development Fundamentals-II**  
**Maximum Time: 02 Hr**  
**Course Title: 15B11CI211**  
**Maximum Marks: 35**

| Course Outcomes | |
| :--- | :--- |
| **CO1** | Explain various object-oriented concepts like class and objects, constructor, abstraction, data hiding (access specifiers etc.) |
| **CO2** | Apply object-oriented concepts like inheritance, polymorphism and templates to real-world problems. |
| **CO3** | Apply SQL commands to create tables and perform various operations like insert, delete, select on the tables. |
| **CO4** | Analyze the source code for possible outcomes, exceptions and to debug the errors. |
| **CO5** | Design and implement class diagram for varied real life problems using OOPs. |

**Note: Attempt all questions.**

**Q1:** Suppose you are organising the 'car of the year' poll and hence you want to store the rating (1-5) for each car along with the car name. A car can have any number of rating associated with it. However, the overall rating of the car is the average of all the rating it has. Write a program in C++ that can serve the following functionality using an appropriate STL container:  
a) Store the rating of at least three cars.  
b) Display the car with highest average rating as car of the year.  
****

**Q2: Write appropriate SQL statements to perform the following tasks:**

| PaintingName | Artist | Year | Country | Valuation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Monalisa | Leonardo da vinci | 1506 | Italy | 860 |
| Water Lilies | Claude Monel | 1920 | France | 600 |
| The last Judgement | Michelangelo | 1741 | Italy | 700 |
| Interior | Edger Degas | 1869 | France | 543 |

a) Create the given relation 'Painting' where primary key is a combination of Artist, Year & Country. Populate the table with any two records provided in the table given above.  
b) Add a new column named 'Period' to the above table. Set the Period of all the paintings belonging to the year 1500 to 1600 as "Renaissance" and remaining ones with the value "Impressionism".  
c) Display the average valuation of paintings from each country.  
d) Display all the Italian paintings whose valuation is above 500.  
e) Display all the artists whose has string "on" in their names and belongs to either Italy or France.  
****

You can use additional functions if needed.

Q5: Equity and forex are two popular financial instruments where investors can invest their money. Create the following classes and design a function in C++ that can take an instance of each of these class and display the details of the better yielding financial instrument. The yield of an equity is ((BuyPrice - CMP) * Quantity) / BuyPrice while the yield of the forex is ((QuotePrice - BasePrice) * LotSize * Noof Lots) / (QuotePrice + BasePrice). You can add additional getter, setter and other methods as per your convenience.

[DIAGRAM: UML class diagram with two classes:
1. Class "Equity"
Attributes:
-BuyPrice(int)
-CMP(int)
-Quantity(int)

2. Class "Forex"
Attributes:
-QuotePrice(int)
-BasePrice(int)
-LotSize(int)
-Noof Lots(int)]
